Name: Baseball Bats of Perfection - ENGLISH
Author: FazyD32
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]

Tired of Swinging a heavy sledgehammer? How about replacing it with something lighter and more graceful? This mod replaces your iridium hammer, as well as the galaxy hammer, with baseball bats with identical stats.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

This mod supports configuration using the config file or the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu"[/url], which, if desired, will allow you to replace the Galaxy Sword and Infinity Sword models.
[b][size=4]
[/size][/b][b][size=4]From the author[/size][/b]

As well as an update of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14841]previous mod[/url]. Have a good summer and good luck to all!
